decision: The new operator profile justified a targeted image MLP row-partition experiment (49), but actual Dev showed a substantial regression with no peak-allocation benefit. Reject that method, preserve its feedback, and retain experiment 41. No further supported partition/orientation variation was identified; reopen only for a concrete new method or kernel-level evidence.

public_operator_profile_review.scope: Own experiment 41, one public case, first and next forward. Not a new score.
public_operator_profile_review.annotation_caution: Inclusive times can overlap and are perturbed by instrumentation. CPU-side and device-only rows were kept separate rather than double-counted.
public_operator_profile_review.actionable_finding: Image MLP is the largest recurring CPU-side inclusive CUDA annotation: about 31.435 ms across 28 layers on the next forward. Cached text MLP/attention annotations have zero CUDA work then.
public_operator_profile_review.decision: Two independent CFG-batch MLPs preserve predictions but regress reward to 0.6479712186197056. Reject finer partition trials without evidence of a different kernel advantage.

public_stage_profile_review.integrity: Raw SHA256 matches source index; artifact and run match experiment 41; all three baseline and candidate stage sums exactly match original Dev feedback.
public_stage_profile_review.finding: First forward takes 124-127 ms; typical later forwards take 58-59 ms. Approximately 67 ms excess over later-stage medians is consistent with included prefix construction, but cannot be attributed to specific operations from this whole-decoder profile.
public_stage_profile_review.reason_for_no_evaluation: No changed graph with a newly supported algorithmic argument was identified; unchanged repeats and unsupported variant sweeps would not resolve an evidence-based hypothesis.

scope: Own independent native Bifrost-1 decoder research using the fixed public operator catalog and real public Dev evaluations. This is a research stopping judgment, not a proof of global optimality.

latest_test.decision: Valid, but neither reward nor total peak allocation improves the best method. Preserve the entire experiment.

non_improving_evidence.direction: Full and down-only image MLP multiplication orientation
Direct channel-layout output projection with batched and single-matrix contractions
KV-grouped probability/value products in both orientations
Isolated grouped scores and combined grouped attention
Two independent query-axis tiles with shared full keys/values
Split image MLP into independent 256-row CFG batches

catalog_constraints: Full gate/up fused weights have 135790592 elements, exceeding the 100000000-element tensor bound.
Retaining all permissible split gate/up fused weights across 28 layers requires 7604273152 BF16 bytes, exceeding the 7 GiB prefix budget before other caches.
No custom fused normalization, residual or MLP epilogue kernels, sparse updates or incremental cache mutation are available.
Remaining image hidden states depend on changing image tokens; unconditional first-stage prefix reuse has no preservation argument.
Final image normalization and projection are fixed evaluator operations after the editable layer DAG.
limitations: Candidate reward comparisons use separate evaluations and are not paired statistical tests between candidates.
Hidden prompts and formal 256-stage evaluation remain untested.
Other combinatorial graphs may exist; no further sufficiently supported method direction was identified.
